Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of
right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Over the course of 40 visits,
care consisted of physical therapy, anti-inflammatory medication, activity
modification, and a home exercise program, consistent with a typical course of
conservative management for this type of injury. The mechanism described is a
plausible cause of the knee complaints reported. Examination findings included
localized tenderness and mild effusion that support the reported injury, while
ligamentous stability testing and neurovascular assessment were within normal limits.
No prior injury or treatment involving this knee has been identified in the available
history. Treatment frequency tapered as the patient's pain and mobility improved, and
the patient was discharged to independent home exercise with instructions to return if
symptoms recur. Billing records reflect services rendered as documented, with no
dupilcate or repeated charges identified.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
